svg.text: Avalanche Validator Lifecycle Model v0.8.0: Differential Execution Specification
Rigorous Implementation Mapping: Two-PSUB cadCAD Architecture, Internal Six-Stage Pipeline, Parallel State Updates, and Invariant Verification
Refit per run: renewal, return, arrival
PSUB 0: Main Daily Lifecycle Transition Block
Executed via single policy function p_lifecycle calling run_stages() across six linear stages
Day Context & Feedback Signal Evaluation: G(S_t ; D_menu, ψ_prot)
Prepares Day(t, start, draw, blocks, renewal_gap, entry_gap, settings). Evaluates renewal yield gap g_t^(R) and entry yield gap g_t^(E).
Yield feedback signals feed directly into Renewal Logit (Stage 1) and Negative-Binomial Arrivals (Stage 3).
Strict execution order: earlier stage outputs pass sequentially via mapping `earlier` to subsequent stages
Participation Candidates N_t = (renews, comes_back, arrivals) pool into Continuation
Part B: Stake Choice s' ∈ [2k, 3M] AVAX
injects scheduled Q_t due today (bypasses stages 1-5)
COMMON POLICY SIGNAL = assembly_stage outputs (stakes, days, out_stakes, issued_navax...)
State-Update Function Bank: Parallel Updates on Pre-PSUB State X_t
All 24 functions receive (params, substep, history, state=X_t, signal). Executed in parallel, not sequentially.

*Adapted Visual Convention: In BlockScience/Polkadot engineering specifications, pentagons frequently denote control functions. Here, pentagons denote deterministic protocol mechanisms and state-update operations.
Traceability Matrix & Verified Model Boundaries (model-v0.8.0 at b18a4a2)
• Exact PSUB Count: Exactly 2 blocks per daily step (checked_blocks in engine.py:89).
• Stage Orchestration: run_stages executes stages sequentially; earlier passes to later.
• Parallel State Updates: All 24 update functions read pre-PSUB state and common signal.
• Supply Accumulation: s_supply computes state["supply"] + signal["issued"] (not sequential).
• Validation Timing: p_invariants runs in PSUB 1 immediately after all state updates.
• Error Raising: Raises InvariantError on failure, terminating run without corruption.
• Renewal Logit: node_record disabled (held at 0.0) in released v0.8.0 configuration.
• Return Hazard: Piecewise logistic hazard across 6 day-out bins (8..365d); no yield term.
• Arrivals Count: Negative Binomial count model; daily mean capped at 100.0 nodes/day.
• Continuation Duration: Empirical duration table (4 bins) for renewals/returns; first_days for new.
• StakeChoice Law: Two-part hurdle (p) + 10 log-spaced stake bands; 50-obs fallback threshold.
• Stake Uncertainty: Fixed point estimate across runs (stake hurdle not resampled).
• PRNG Innovations: Stateless keyed draws (draw.uniforms) tie randomness to entity identity.
• Constant Minimum Stake: Released model strictly enforces S_min = 2,000 AVAX for all d in [14, 365].
• Proposed Admission Frontier: S_min(d) = S_floor + (S_short - S_floor)η(d)^p is NOT active/enforced.
• Uptime / Slashing: No uptime tracking, liveness checks, or slashing exist in v0.8.0.
• Gross Potential Rewards: issued_navax reflects gross potential rewards without uptime forfeiture.
• Identity Representation: Concentration measured over simulated node_keys, not corporate entities.
• Scheduled Commitments: Exogenous inputs (Q_t) bypass duration and stake choice mechanisms.
• Delegations & Operators: Excluded from v0.8.0; scheduled for v0.8.1 delegation lifecycle.
